description: §21.3 / §41.3.1 — importing `{ isValid }` from `scrml:data`, which exports it (by re-export from data/validate.scrml), resolves cleanly; E-IMPORT-004 stays silent. The clean twin of the stdlib name-not-exported case.
rationale: §21.3 applies to `scrml:` imports (§41.3.1); a name in the module's export list — a re-export counts — is legal.
